descriptions.zh-Hans: 在巴黎吃法棍时画的断面，留着几处大小不一的气孔。旁边记了掰开外壳的一声轻响。
descriptions.en: My sketch of baguette in Paris, with uneven pockets in its cut surface and a note about the small crack of the crust.

descriptions.zh-Hans: 我在巴黎尝过的环形泡芙，纸上标了第一口从哪里开始。箭头是我的回忆，没有规定吃法。
descriptions.en: A ring of choux pastry I tried in Paris, with an arrow marking my first bite. A personal memory, with no instructions for anyone else's fork.

names.en: Near Which Part of the Tower?

descriptions.zh-Hans: 在巴黎看埃菲尔铁塔时，我给“塔那边见”补上的具体位置。它只记着我和旅人的那次约定。
descriptions.en: The detail I added to “near the tower” while meeting a traveler in Paris. It keeps our own arrangement for that visit.

descriptions.zh-Hans: 我在巴黎吃过圆圆的巴黎布雷斯特泡芙后留下的箭头。它指向的是那天下午的开头。
descriptions.en: My arrow after a Paris-Brest in Paris. It points to the beginning of that particular afternoon.

descriptions.zh-Hans: 看巴黎卢浮宫玻璃金字塔时，我画的三角和方框。它们提醒我慢一点看玻璃后面与表面的影子。
descriptions.en: A triangle and square I drew by the Louvre Pyramid in Paris, reminders to notice both the view through the glass and its reflections.

descriptions.zh-Hans: 我和旅人在巴黎商量好的两行碰面办法，还有一个挥手的小身影。这张折卡不是铁塔的官方导览。
descriptions.en: Two lines agreed with a traveler in Paris, plus a tiny waving figure. Our homemade meeting card, rather than an Eiffel Tower guide.
